This was our second track fixture and took place on April 29th at Tooting Track, as a triangular match between Hercules A.C., Mitcham A.C., and ourselves. There were events for both Seniors and Juniors, and in the latter we had Adams 4th and Palmer 6th in the 220, Frank Wright 1st, and J.
In the Junior match we again triumphed, with 29 pts., with Shaftesbury H., 22 ; and Ealing and Maidenhead, 8 each. John Smith scored a double win in the 100 and 220, with J.

There was also an open Schools 4 x 110 yds. relay, which was won by the Drayton Manor School in 48.2 secs. In the Junior match we had John Smith 1st in the 100, with Ian Forrester winning the 220 yds., Frank Wright won the 440, with J.
We could not field a team in the Junior 4 x 110 yds. owing to some of our lads being unable to obtain leave from their Service Units, but in the Junior Medley Relay our team of Frank Wright, J.
Also on the programme was an Inter-Club Junior match, and we fared better in this and came out on top of the six competing clubs. John Smith was 3rd in both the 100 and 220 yds., with J.
Jones, the Surrey Junior champion, won his heat in the 80 yds., but was unlucky to be disqualified in the final for two false starts. J.
Smith in the 220 yds. both failed to get through their heats, as did J.
